subject: Proposal: MSA redline triage + staged onboarding windows

Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@novagrid.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Novagrid MSA v3 – redline + calendar windows for kickoff

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Attached is our consolidated set of redlines (Novagrid_MSA_v3_redline.pdf). We need to lock a short triage call to run through the clauses that impact data residency, audit logs, and breach notification timelines.

Can your legal/procurement team do a 45-minute session this week? Our preference is either:
- Thu 1/14 10:00–10:45 PT
- Fri 1/15 09:00–09:45 PT

If neither works, please propose two alternatives (we're on Pacific time, but can shift an hour earlier/later). Also attaching a preliminary onboarding evidence checklist — would appreciate confirmation of owners before the call.

Attachments: Novagrid_MSA_v3_redline.pdf (PDF), onboarding-evidence-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

Best,
Elena Márquez
Contracts & Ops | Novagrid

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the packet, received and skimmed. We can do a focused 45-minute triage. Thursday 1/14 at 10:00 PT is open on our side but I want to confirm Marissa as the runbook owner and Karthik for technical SSO/audit details.

Proposed agenda (short):
1) Quick roll call & scope (5m)
2) Data residency / audit log obligations (20m)
3) Incident response & notification SLA discussion (10m)
4) Owners / follow-ups + next steps (10m)

Marissa — would you take point on the evidence checklist and prepare the internal owners mapping? Karthik — can you scan the SSO/audit clauses and flag anything blocking from a delivery perspective?

If Thu 10:00 PT is a hard no for Novagrid, suggest Fri 09:00 PT as backup.

-Kim

Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novagrid MSA v3 – redline + calendar windows for kickoff

Kim / Elena —

I took a pass on the attached checklist. Quick notes before the triage:
- Evidence owners: Security (Karthik) for SOC/KV cache logs, Product Ops (me) for onboarding runbooks, Customer Success (TBD) for training materials.
- Data residency: Novagrid flagged EU residency in clause 7.2 — we should confirm expected regions for pilot (US-only or multi-region).
- Incident timelines: propose we align on 24-hr acknowledgement, 72-hr initial remediation update — can be softened to 48/7x24 for enterprise customers if required.

For the call, I propose we break the 45m into a two-stage pattern: 25m targeted redline triage (clauses that materially affect launch) + 20m onboarding coordination (owners & immediate evidence list). That keeps follow-ups focused.

Availability: Thursday 1/14 10:00 PT still works for me. I can circulate a one-page prep doc (internal-msa-triage-agenda.docx) with highlighted clauses by 1/13 EOD.

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Also: Elena asked me to confirm the evidence we referenced. Can you confirm the format for the onboarding evidence (spreadsheet vs. Drive folder), and whether we should include screenshots of audit dashboards or just raw logs?

Tom / Elena —

9:00–9:45 PT on Thu 1/14 would conflict with a standing leadership sync on our side (apologies, missed that earlier). We will keep the original Thu 10:00–10:45 PT slot. If Novagrid cannot make 10:00, we will default to Fri 09:00 PT. Please confirm final preference by EOD today and I'll send a calendar invite.

On evidence format: Marissa will prepare the spreadsheet with owners mapped; screenshots are fine as supplemental items, but primary deliverable should be logs/exportable artifacts (CSV or syslog) where possible — saves back-and-forth during SOC review.
